label: One-being controls for the Dei Filius sufficiency bridges
paraphrase: Closed controls on one-being interpretations whose single being is God, with Unit respects and principles: (1) every premise of nineGiveDeiFilius holds and the being has the nine and every Dei Filius attribute; (2) for each of nine of its ten premises (all but goodness-is-actuality: living, lord, almighty, immense, incomprehensible, blessed, no component, excess in act, matter-form composition) an interpretation where every other premise holds and the being has the nine but not every Dei Filius attribute; (3) an interpretation where the field interpretation holds while STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE fails. Statements about these interpretations only.
